extra_config.description: PBR split-scope (soft) with 10 reviewers (4 TESTER / 3 USER / 3 DESIGNER) — supplementary analysis, one section anchor each + A/B escape hatch.
focus_areas: Message Sequence Charts (MSC) in sections 3.x and 4.x
reviewer_focus:
YOUR ASSIGNED SCOPE: Section 3.1 (overall design structure, top-level signal flow). Concentrate on missing top-level signals, structural gaps between requirements and 3.1, and inconsistencies that propagate into the lower sections. Always cite the exact signal name (e.g. 'Order') in your evidence. Primary focus: assigned sections. Outside your focus you MAY log clear A/B defects only if you include precise location (section + page/table/msc) and evidence. Do not broaden search outside focus. Within your focus, log defects of any risk (A/B/C); outside your focus, only A/B.
YOUR ASSIGNED SCOPE: Section 3.2.1 (data structures, request/order signals). Concentrate on missing or wrong signal definitions, parameter types, and data structure completeness for the request/order family. Cross-check each signal name against Table 1. Always cite the exact signal name (e.g. 'Reject_Order', 'Cancel_Order') in your evidence. Primary focus: assigned sections. Outside your focus you MAY log clear A/B defects only if you include precise location (section + page/table/msc) and evidence. Do not broaden search outside focus. Within your focus, log defects of any risk (A/B/C); outside your focus, only A/B.
YOUR ASSIGNED SCOPE: Section 3.2.2 (user-side signals, taxi/driver interactions). Concentrate on missing user-side signals, wrong parameter types, and inconsistencies between the requirements text and 3.2.2. Always cite the exact signal name (e.g. 'Login', 'Log_Out') in your evidence. Primary focus: assigned sections. Outside your focus you MAY log clear A/B defects only if you include precise location (section + page/table/msc) and evidence. Do not broaden search outside focus. Within your focus, log defects of any risk (A/B/C); outside your focus, only A/B.

Outside your focus you MAY log clear A/B defects only if you include precise location (section + page/table/msc) and evidence. Do not broaden search outside focus. YOUR ASSIGNED SCOPE: Section 3.4.1 (taxi MSC, signal sequencing on the car side). Concentrate on missing signals in the MSC, wrong sequencing, and missing reject/cancel paths.
